preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each initial value p_i on a vertex must be a distinct integer between 1 and n.
The number of initial values p must equal the number of vertices n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.
The number of edges must equal m.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] in [1, 2] and (query[0] == 1 and 1 <= query[1] <= n) or (query[0] == 2 and 1 <= query[1] <= m)) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must be either of type 1 with a valid vertex or type 2 with a valid edge index.

postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output must be the maximum value p_u among reachable vertices, followed by a newline.
After processing queries, at least one vertex must have a value of 0.
